end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Counted examples including 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, and 18.
Discussed that the tens digit comes first, followed by the ones digit.
The 14 versus 41 mix-up was corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making numbers with one group of ten and extra ones, then counting forward to name the number. Using the full ten frame and saying “ten, then…” helped them reach answers such as 12, 13, 14, 16, and 18. They mixed up the order in 14 and 41, but corrected it by placing the ten digit first. At home, show one group of 10 objects with 1–9 extra objects and ask Saanvi to say and write the number.
